content:
200
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully retrieved the scan routes list for the
specified scanner group.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
Array [
string
A hostname, hostname wildcard, IP address, CIDR address, or IP range.
For more information about supported route formats, see Supported
Scan Routing Target Formats.
]
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters or if your request was improperly formatted.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to view the scan routes list.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management could not find the specified scanner group.
